title: Quickly Spherified Dutch Fish Pilaf
description: A spicy, fluffy, and impressive Dutch dish featuring bay leaves, spherification, and a convenient bamboo-tray serving vessel.
instructions: Rinse the cod fillets under cold water, pat them dry with a paper towel, and season with salt and black pepper.
In a medium saucepan, combine the rice, 2 cups of water, and a pinch of salt.
Bring the mixture to a boil, reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes.
In a separate saucepan, combine the bay leaves, chili flakes, and 1 cup of water.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Strain the bay leaf mixture through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean bowl, discarding the bay leaves.
Stir in the lemon juice, sodium alginate, and butter until dissolved.
Add the cooked rice to the bay leaf mixture and stir to combine.
Using a spherification spoon or a syringe, create small spheres of the rice mixture and drop them into a bath of cold water.
Once the spheres have formed, remove them from the water with a slotted spoon and add them to a bamboo-tray serving vessel.
Place a cod fillet on top of each sphere, drizzle with a little extra butter, and serve immediately.
